newsitem.title: UK: Vendome signs agreement to buy Lancel.
newsitem.headline: Vendome signs agreement to buy Lancel.

text.p: Vendome Luxury Goods Plc said on Thursday it had agreed to acquire Lancel, the French leather goods group for an estimated 342 million Swiss francs.

"The acquisition of Lancel will continue to reinforce Vendome's position in the luxury leather goods market," said the group in a statement. Lancel has 85 outlets, especially concentrated in France, where the flagship store opened in 1929 at Place de l'Opera in Paris.

Under the terms of the agreement, Vendome will acquire a 90 percent stake in Lancel in cash and the remainder maybe bought for cash over a period of several years. The group said the acquisition will have no material effect on its finances.
Vendome already has a number of leather goods businesses with Cartier, Alfred Dunhill, Montblanc and Seegar brands.

With a young image and a wider customer base, Lancel will complement these existing businesses and assume the role of the leather goods specialist in the Vendome Group," said the company in a statement.
The acquisition will lead to an increase of around 40 percent in Vendome's sales of leather goods, making it the most important line behind watches and jewellery.
Jean Zorbibe, currently chairman and a shareholder of Lancel, will remain as chairman and become a minority shareholder in Lancel.
